overload_type_resolution.description: Boolean or non-complex numeric scalars, arrays and clusters are accepted. Boolean leaves produce Boolean; integer leaves retain/promote their representation; floating leaves coerce to I32. Error-cluster input uses status. Boolean and numeric leaves cannot mix. Arrays are processed element by element and retain their rank. Multiple array operands must have the same rank; a scalar operand is applied to every element.
